title: Inspired
subtitle: 「受到啟發／激勵／感動」，要先分清是產生行動動力、作品受到來源影響、想法被激發，還是情感上受到觸動。
description: 「受到啟發／激勵／感動」，要先分清是產生行動動力、作品受到來源影響、想法被激發，還是情感上受到觸動。

words.example: The speech left the students motivated to work harder.
words.exampleZh: 這場演講令學生更有動力努力學習。

exercises.original: The speech left the students inspired to work harder.
exercises.zh: 演講令學生受到激勵，更想努力。
exercises.upgrade: The speech left the students motivated to work harder.

options.explanation: to work harder shows action-oriented motivation, making motivated the best fit。
excited only describes emotional arousal。
interested is much weaker and does not imply effort。
impressed means admiring the speech, not acting because of it。
moved is emotional rather than goal-directed。
influenced is broader and does not specify motivation.

exercises.original: She felt inspired to apply for the programme after meeting a former student.
exercises.zh: 見過一名前學生後，她有動力申請該課程。
exercises.upgrade: She felt motivated to apply for the programme after meeting a former student.

options.explanation: to apply is a concrete intended action, so motivated is precise。
impressed/excited/interested do not guarantee action。
moved focuses emotion。
stimulated is more natural for ideas or interest than an application decision.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The team was inspired to improve after the poor result.

options.explanation: poor result leading to greater effort is motivation。

moved is emotional。
interested is too weak。
influenced only does not capture the renewed drive.

falseSynonyms.zh: 興奮不等於 inspired excited 是情緒高漲；inspired 常帶新想法、理想或行動動力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Excitement may accompany inspiration but is not the same.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有興趣不等於 inspired interested 只表示注意／好奇；inspired 通常更強。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interest is weaker than inspiration.

falseSynonyms.zh: 印象深刻不等於 inspired impressed 是覺得出色；不一定因此產生行動或創意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Admiration does not necessarily create inspiration.

falseSynonyms.zh: influenced 只在『受到來源影響』sense 接近 inspired influence 可以正面、負面或無意識；inspiration 通常更正面、有創意／激勵意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Influence is broader and more neutral.

falseSynonyms.zh: motivated 只在『有行動動力』sense 接近 inspired motivation 聚焦想做／努力做；inspiration 還可指創意來源。
encouraged 通常比 inspired 輕 encouraged 強調得到信心或支持；inspired 往往更強、更理想化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Encouragement is often milder.

falseSynonyms.zh: moved 是情感觸動，不保證產生行動或創意 一個故事可以令人感動，但未必令人受到啟發。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Being moved is emotional; being inspired may lead further.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 inspire 是動詞；inspired 是形容詞／過去分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Inspire is a verb; inspired describes the resulting state.
